select
  md.id
  ,md.trvdesc
  ,Replace(md.Description,' ') Description
  ,md.can_insert mod_insert
  ,md.can_delete mod_delete
  ,md.can_update mod_update 
  ,md.advanced_grants
 ,sba.cur_user 
 ,Decode(sba.can_insert,null,0,sba.can_insert) as can_insert
 ,Decode(sba.can_update,null,0,sba.can_delete) as can_delete
 ,Decode(sba.can_delete,null,0,sba.can_update) as can_update
 ,SB_ACA.checkmodaccess_int(description,:USERNAME) as "Select"
 ,md.rowid
 from modules md ,
  (select *
   from sba_usergrants sba
   where cur_user=UPPER(:USERNAME)) sba 
  where
  UPPER(Replace(md.Description,' ')) =sba.cur_module(+)

datasets.name: repUsersGrantsData
datasets.sql:
select * from
(select
  s.name,
  s.id as modid,
  s.trvdesc, 
  decode(s.ModAcc ,1,:GRANTED,:NOTGRANTED) as "Can use",
  decode(sba.can_insert,1,:GRANTED,:NOTGRANTED) as "Can insert",
  decode(sba.can_delete,1,:GRANTED,:NOTGRANTED) as "Can Delete",
  decode(sba.can_update,1,:GRANTED,:NOTGRANTED) as "Can Update"
from
  (SELECT u.name,m.id,m.trvdesc,m.description,SB_ACA.checkmodaccess_int(description,u.name) as ModAcc, 
  sb_aca.isadm_num (u.NAME) AS is_adm  
  FROM modules m ,user$ u
  order by u.name) s,
  sba_usergrants sba
where
  s.is_adm<>1 and
  s.modacc<>0 
  and  sba.cur_user(+)=UPPER(s.name) 
  and  sba.cur_module (+)=s.description 

UNION 

  SELECT grantsadv.username as name, 
  grantsMod.moduleid as modid,
  grantsMod.Advdescription as trvdesc,
  :GRANTED as "Can Use",null,null,null
  FROM sba_usergrants_advanced grantsadv,
  (select modgrants.id advgrantid, modgrants.description Advdescription,modgrants.moduleid
   from sba_advanced_grants modgrants) grantsMod
   where grantsadv.advancedgrantid=grantsMod.advgrantid
   and grantsadv.username in 
        (select name from user$)
) AllGrants
where name=:name
   order by name,trvdesc

datasets.name: AccountsData
datasets.sql:
select
  acc.ID as AccID,
  acc.OP_ID,
  acc.ACC_NO as AccNo,
  acc.NAME as AccName,
  acc.OPEN_DAT as OpenDate,
  acc.CLOSE_DAT as CloseDate,
  acc.VAL_ACC as CurrencyID,
  acc.bal_cn1 as SAcc,
  acc.bal_cn2 as SAcc2,
  acc.bal_cn3 as SAcc3,
  acc.bal_cn4 as SAcc4,
  acc.KLI_ID as CustomerID,
  acc.PAIR_ACC as PairAcc,
  acc.Limit as AccLimit,
  acc.SIM_OTCET as ReportSymbol,
  acc.tipacc as AccFlags , 
  acc.FILIAL as FilialID,
  acc.Insider as Insider,
  Currency.VAL_NAME as CurrencySName,
  acc.rowid
from
  ACCOUNT acc,
  AVALUTE Currency
where
 (Currency.VALUTE = acc.VAL_ACC)

datasets.name: TransactionsData
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  p.rowid,
  p.ID,
  p.OP_ID,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,
  ad.filial as DebFil,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,
  ac.filial as CredFil,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  p.VID_OP as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance, 
  p.Name,
  p.Vid_op as OperationType
FROM
  provarch p,
 account ad,
 account ac,
 avalute dc,
 avalute cc
where
 p.dat = :DAT
 and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
 and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
 and (ad.val_acc = p.val_acc)
 and (ac.val_acc = p.CurrencyID_C)
 and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc) 
 and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
  ORDER BY p.ID

datasets.name: KreditsData
datasets.sql:
Select
    Contracts.rowid,
    Contracts.ID
   ,Contracts.ContractNo
   ,Contracts.SID#  as OP_ID      
   ,Contracts.OpenDate
   ,to_char(OpenDate,'DD') as MonthDay
   ,Contracts.CloseDate
   ,Contracts.Amount
   ,Contracts.ContractType
   ,Contracts.PledgeType
   ,Contracts.ReliabilityID
   ,Contracts.OverdueReliabilityID
   ,Contracts.ClientType
   ,Contracts.PledgePrice
   ,ContractAccs.ContractAccID
   ,ContractAccs.ClientAccID
   ,ContractAccs.ReserveAccID
   ,ContractAccs.InterestAccID
   ,ContractAccs.OverdueAccID
   ,ContractAccs.OverdueInterestAccID
   ,ContractAccs.OverdueReserveAccID
   ,ContractState.FacticalDebt
   ,ContractState.FacticalInterestDebt
   ,ContractState.OverdueDebt
   ,ContractState.OverdueInterestDebt
   ,ContractState.StopCalculationDate
   ,ContractState.CalculationEnabled
   ,ContractState.ReguiredAmountDec
   ,ContractState.ReguiredPercentDec
   ,ContractState.LastProcessDate
   ,ContractState.ResiduaryAmount
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccNoFromID(ContractAccs.ContractAccID) as ContractAccNo
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccNoFromID(ContractAccs.InterestAccID) as InterestAccNo
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetCurrencyShortName(ContractAccs.ContractAccID)as ContractCurrency
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccName(ContractAccs.ContractAccID) as ContractAccName   
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.GetContractCurrency(Contracts.ID) as ContractCurrencyID
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.CheckContractState(Contracts.ID) as  Status
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.GetAccountBalance(ContractAccs.InterestAccID) as InterestBalance
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.GetAccountBalance(ContractAccs.ClientAccID) as ClientBalance
From
   SBCM_Contracts Contracts
  ,SBCM_Contract_Accounts ContractAccs
  ,SBCM_Contract_State ContractState
Where
   Contracts.Type# in (1,2) And 
    Contracts.ID = ContractAccs.ID#
   And Contracts.ID = ContractState.ID#
order by ContractNo

   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccNoFromID(ContractAccs.InterestAccID) as InterestAccNo
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetCurrencyShortName(ContractAccs.ContractAccID)as ContractCurrency
